reply_text:
I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100.

Ilse first posted 261 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random to 100, saying she'd read the wrong line. I told Dana to use 100 for the tracker, not 261.

Dana is a member of #north-random, so the correction is something she can see herself. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to post in #north-team.
